data.text: Applying DEC-20 further: SPEC.md and scripts/kadence.mjs are out of git too. Three scripts had to stay, and the reason is worth keeping — something committed needs each one. build.mjs: npm run build, CI, the test globalSetup. reference.mjs: npm run reference, release.yml, and it ships inside the npm package. north-star.mjs: test/north-star.test.ts spawns it. Removing any of them turns a fresh clone red, which local tests cannot catch, because git rm --cached leaves every file on disk. The check that does catch it is: git archive $(git write-tree) into a temp dir, npm ci, build, test.
